user_query: I want to fetch the labels detected in an image of a mouthwatering dish, list domain-specific models supported by Microsoft Computer Vision API, and find web pages related to cooking.

TaskList.description: Use an image processing API to analyze the image of the dish and fetch the labels detected.
Query Microsoft Computer Vision API to retrieve a list of domain-specific models it supports.
Perform a web search to find and aggregate web pages related to cooking.
